text: The cause of the fluidity of the primordial element is its inherent nature; the fluidity of earth, water, and fire is of various kinds, being either inherent or occasional. The inherent fluidity is found in water; the occasional fluidity is found in earth and fire. In earth, the fluidity of ghee and the like is produced by contact with fire; in fire, the fluidity of gold and the like. ॥ 31 ॥
